# SIFS

**Author:** Andreas Ziemer<br/>
**Platforms:** x65/x75 (SGOLD)

SIFS is a Total Commander file plugin for accessing the FlexMemory of Siemens phones
via serial port and OBEX. It allows you to browse directories,
copy, move, rename, and delete files directly from Total
Commander.

This modification of SIFS 1.1 supports Siemens x65. Total Commander
5.51 or later is required.
